messages.text: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer in Automotive, and what evidence supports each opportunity?

### Evidence-supported opportunities
| Opportunity area | Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer angle | Supporting evidence | Evidence strength / caveat |
|---|---|---|---|
| NG eCall / IMS eCall over 4G/5G in automotive | CMX500 is not presented as a standalone signal generator/analyzer, but its RF unit provides FR1 vector signal analysis and ARB-based generator functions, and its NGeCall configurations include CMX500 application-test software and audio/IP options.[76][41][10] | eCall has been mandatory for new cars sold in the EU since 2018, 2G/3G circuit-switched networks are becoming obsolete, and the source says NG eCall will be obligatory from 2026-01-01.[71] | Direct automotive evidence exists, but the instrument role is mainly mobile radio tester/application test rather than standalone Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer.[31][72] |
| NG eCall validation with automotive modem platforms | CMX500 with CMX-KA098 is explicitly described as usable for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions.[31] | Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm Technologies used CMX500 to verify NG eCall functionality of Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF against EN 17240:2024, including voice and data transmission while simulating a PSAP.[7][31] | Strong direct evidence for automotive 4G/5G eCall test demand, but the source is PR-level verification and not a formal certification report or complete test plan.[9] |
| eCall GNSS testing | SMBV100B is explicitly listed as the vector signal generator base unit for eCall GNSS Testing configuration.[40][41] | The CMX configuration guide includes an “eCall GNSS Testing” section and points to an SMBV100B-based eCall GNSS test configuration.[34][41] | Direct signal-generator-to-automotive-eCall evidence exists, but the configuration guide is not a technical specifications datasheet or formal quote source.[36] |
| Automotive radar sensor validation / radar echo generation | AREG800A is an Automotive Radar Echo Generator for dynamic artificial object generation, with radar object distance, Doppler, IF bandwidth, 76 GHz to 81 GHz radar frontends, and HiL/OSI support documented.[61][60][63][68] | AREG800A supports hybrid and digital echo generation up to 3000 m, individual Doppler frequency shift per artificial object, velocity setting range ±500 km/h with AREG8-B9 and AREG8-B63, and HiL interface option AREG8-K109 with OSI and gPTP/NTP synchronization.[60][63][68] | This is a strong automotive radar test opportunity, but the vault explicitly says AREG800A is not an RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer.[5] |
| Automotive radar measurement ecosystem | Spectrum analyzer use appears in the AREG800A Doppler offset measurement condition, and vector network analyzer use appears in ghost-object suppression measurement conditions.[63][64] | Doppler frequency offset accuracy is measured in the IF domain with a spectrum analyzer, and ghost-object suppression is measured with a vector network analyzer in time domain.[63][64] | The evidence supports analyzer involvement in measurement methods, but it does not tie a specific R&S Signal Analyzer product such as FSW or FSVA3000 to automotive radar testing.[63][64][25][57] |
| 5G NTN testing where automotive is a named interested sector | SMW200A is presented as signal generator/channel emulator, and FSW is presented as signal/spectrum analysis instrument for NTN component testing and SAN transmitter measurement.[16][17] | The NTN source says 5G NTN-NR is gaining interest from chipset/device manufacturers, automotive, and satellite/space industry, and says SMW200A channel emulation capabilities for NTN include long path delays, enhanced Doppler, and customized dynamic fading.[83] | This is an automotive-adjacent opportunity with explicit automotive interest, but the evidence does not provide an automotive-specific NTN test case or customer requirement.[83][90] |
| NTN component testing with generator and analyzer pair | Component testing uses DUT, SMW200A, and FSW; SMW200A is summarized as frequency up to 67 GHz, overrange 72 GHz, RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz or up to 4 GHz with SMW-K555, while FSW is summarized as frequency up to 85 GHz, overrange 90 GHz, and analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz.[89] | The same source lists SMW200A signal generation software for LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18, OFDM, and custom digital modulation, and FSW signal analysis software for LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18, OFDM signal analysis, and vector signal analysis.[89] | The signal-generator/analyzer pairing is directly supported for NTN component testing, but the automotive link is only the broader statement that automotive is interested in 5G NTN-NR.[83][89] |
| NTN SAN conformance / channel emulation | SMW200A SAN testing key features include FRCs, test models, fading, AWGN, propagation models, TDL and moving propagation, SISO/MIMO, NB-IoT options, NR options, and B14/B15 plus K71 moving propagation.[82] | The SAN testing source ties NR SAN to 3GPP TS 38.108 and TS 38.181, and states SMW B10/B14 supports testing needs up to 160 MHz while SMW B9/B15 supports testing needs up to 200 MHz for TS 38.181 Rel.17 SAN testing requirements.[82][86] | This is strong for signal-generator/channel-emulation opportunity in NTN, but not directly proven as an automotive-specific SAN opportunity.[83][86] |
### Product / option mapping from the current vault
| Product line | Automotive-relevant demand that is actually evidenced | Confirmed product / option facts | Why it fits the evidenced opportunity | Gaps / quote risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | NG eCall over IMS networks for 4G LTE and 5G NR automotive emergency-call testing is evidenced by EN 17240:2024 context and Qualcomm Snapdragon Auto verification.[31][71] | CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD, and CMX-KA098 is named for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions.[72][31] | CMX500 was used to verify NG eCall voice and data transmission while simulating a PSAP, and the CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G configuration lists CMX-KA098 and CMX-KF671B.[7][41] | The verification source is PR-level and does not provide test case IDs, network parameters, IMS setup, GNSS setup, software versions, or pass/fail details.[9] |
| R&S SMBV100B | eCall GNSS testing is evidenced as a specific configuration-guide topic.[34][41] | The CMX configuration guide identifies SMBV100B as the vector signal generator base unit for eCall GNSS Testing and lists GNSS/eCall test suite items.[40][41] | This is the clearest current vault link between an automotive eCall use case and a vector signal generator.[40][41] | The configuration guide is not a technical specifications datasheet, and formal ordering, pricing, and product specifications need official configuration/specification sources.[36] |
| R&S AREG800A | Automotive radar echo generation is directly evidenced for automotive radar testing.[61][60] | AREG800A provides dynamic artificial object generation, hybrid/digital echo generation to 3000 m, per-object Doppler shift, ±500 km/h velocity setting range with AREG8-B9 and AREG8-B63, and 76 GHz to 81 GHz radar-band frontend support.[60][63][68] | It directly addresses automotive radar object, distance, velocity, Doppler, and HiL/OSI test needs.[60][63][68] | The vault explicitly says AREG800A is automotive radar echo generation and not an RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer.[5] |
| R&S SMW200A | 5G NTN-NR is stated to be gaining interest from automotive, and SMW200A is stated to provide NTN channel emulation capabilities.[83] | SMW200A is a vector signal generator that can be expanded to multichannel MIMO receiver tester, supports up to 8 signal sources and up to 64 fading channels, and has RF path A up to 67 GHz with overrange to 72 GHz.[22][92][93] | NTN evidence positions SMW200A for channel emulation, SAN testing, and end-to-end satellite RF link emulation with long path delays, enhanced Doppler, and customized dynamic fading.[16][20][84] | The automotive link is only stated as market interest in 5G NTN-NR, not as a documented automotive test case or customer project.[83][90] |
| R&S FSW | NTN component testing and SAN transmitter measurement are evidenced analyzer roles, and automotive is named as one interested sector for 5G NTN-NR.[16][83] | FSW is a high-end Signal and Spectrum Analyzer family covering 8 GHz to 85 GHz models, and with FSW85 plus FSW-B90G it can extend to 90 GHz.[25] | The NTN component-testing source pairs FSW with SMW200A and summarizes FSW as up to 85 GHz, overrange 90 GHz, and analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz for signal analysis roles.[89] | The current vault does not directly tie FSW to an automotive-specific NTN or radar customer workflow.[83][89] |
| R&S FSVA3000 | The vault only gives a general Signal and Spectrum Analyzer product series and an NTN slide saying 5G NR options on FSW/FSVA support Chapter 6 and 9 measurements.[17][57] | FSVA3000 models cover 10 Hz to 4 GHz through 10 Hz to 50 GHz depending on model.[58] | It may be relevant where a lower/midrange signal analyzer is acceptable for 5G NR measurements, but the automotive use case is not directly evidenced.[17][57] | The current passages do not provide an automotive-specific FSVA3000 opportunity or option stack.[18][57] |
### Scenario cut-in suggestions supported by evidence
| Scenario | Recommended evidence-backed bundle | Cut-in point | Unverified items |
|---|---|---|---|
| NG eCall platform validation for automotive modem suppliers | CMX500 with CMX-KA098, plus CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G configuration items such as CMX-KF671B where the configuration guide lists them.[31][41] | Lead with EN 17240:2024, PSAP simulation, NG eCall voice/data transmission, and realistic network conditions.[7][31] | Formal certification status, test case IDs, software versions, and full pass/fail details are not provided.[9] |
| eCall GNSS test setup | SMBV100B-based eCall GNSS Testing configuration.[34][40][41] | Lead with the configuration-guide evidence that eCall GNSS testing uses SMBV100B as the vector signal generator base unit.[40][41] | Formal SMBV100B specifications, pricing, latest orderability, and complete quote BOM are not provided by the configuration-guide passages.[36] |
| Automotive radar target simulation and HiL | AREG800A with relevant AREG8 options documented for IF bandwidth, Doppler, frontends, HiL, synchronization, and OSI support.[65][68] | Lead with dynamic artificial object generation, distance coverage to 3000 m, per-object Doppler, ±500 km/h velocity range, 76 GHz to 81 GHz radar support, and HiL/OSI support.[60][63][68] | This is not a Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer product opportunity in the strict RF SG/SA sense because the vault classifies AREG800A as automotive radar echo generation, not RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer.[5] |
| NTN component and SAN testing for automotive-interested 5G NTN ecosystem | SMW200A for signal generation/channel emulation and FSW for signal/spectrum analysis in NTN component testing.[16][17][89] | Lead with 5G NTN-NR interest from automotive and SMW200A capabilities for long path delays, enhanced Doppler, and customized dynamic fading.[83] | The source is a 2025 presentation, not a formal datasheet or price book, and it does not prove an automotive-specific NTN test program.[90][83] |
### Short conclusion
The most directly evidenced automotive opportunities are NG eCall / eCall GNSS testing and automotive radar echo generation, while NTN with SMW200A and FSW is a broader Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer opportunity where automotive is named as an interested sector but not tied to a specific automotive test case [31][34][40][41][61][83][89].

- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › RF generator
Output level uncertainties 適用於 continuous wave，不適用於 overrange；wideband applications 可能產生 additional uncertainties。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMW500 › 重要限制
- 來源明示：[[R&S CMW500]] 有時只支援部分測試，某些測試需要進一步設備。
- 多個 CEN/TS 17240 IVS 測試需要外部 HMI interaction、ignition switched OFF 控制、manufacturer specific AT command、IVS debugging tool、prepared TestUSIM 或 handset；這些不完全由 KA09x software 控制。
- CTP 1.1.10.1-IMS limited service condition 標示 Partly Available；需 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，且 attach reject by network not supported yet。
- CTP 1.1.17.2-IMS call-back abnormal termination 標示 Not available。
- 3GPP TS 34.229-1 21.3 標示 Not available。
- 來源註明 legacy CS domain eCall with inband-modem 到 [[NGeCall over LTE]] / IMS 的 transition 尚未由 EU commission 最終決定，因此部分涉及 handover 的 test cases 尚未實作。

R&S CMW500 › 支援技術摘要
- [[R&S CMW500]] 在 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]] 中是唯一明確支援 GSM small cell、WCDMA small cell、LTE small cell 的 CMW 型號。
- GSM、NB-IoT、WCDMA、LTE mobile station test 與 NR Sub-6GHz 章節明確標示適用於 [[R&S CMW500]] 與 [[R&S CMW290]]。
- Four RF paths、DAU B450H/I、Digital I/Q 1 to 4 / 5 to 8、Digital I/Q QUAD 章節明確標示 [[R&S CMW500]] 與 [[R&S CMW270]]。
- Bluetooth standard：Bluetooth Core Specification Version 5.0；test standard 包含 RF.TS.5.0.0 與 RF-PHY.TS.5.0.0。
- WLAN 160 MHz bandwidth unit 章節列出 IEEE 802.11a/g/p/n/ac 與 IEEE 802.11ax，bandwidth up to 160 MHz。
- [[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 補充 [[NGeCall over LTE]]、[[IMS eCall]]、[[IVS]]、[[PSAP]]、[[MSD]]、limited service、callback、clear-down、SRVCC handover 等 eCall 測試語境。

R&S CMW500
R&S CMW500 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Wideband radio communication tester；[[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]]（Version 17.00，April 2023）列出的訂購型號為 R&S®CMW500，Order No. 1201.0002K50；[[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]]（Oct. 2024，文件版次來源未標示）補充其搭配 [[R&S CMW-KA096]] 或 [[R&S CMWrun KT111]] 時的 [[NGeCall over LTE]] 測試支援狀態。

3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR › 重點摘要
此來源是由 `3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR.pptx` 轉出的 lossy markdown；封面標示 `1GP` 與 `12-2025`，末頁標示 `Last updated: 08/25`，其中 slide 27 另標示 `2025-09-29 Nokia Workshop at R&S - SigGen Product Update`。本頁以來源原文呈現的 2025 年簡報語境處理，不自行推論正式發布日。

簡報主題是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 針對 [[3GPP]] [[NTN]] 的 signal generator / channel emulation 測試方案，涵蓋：

- [[5G NTN-NR]] 的 Release 17 / 18 / 19 演進與頻段。
- [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）conformance testing。
- [[NTN signal generator solutions]] 的 component testing、SAN testing、end-to-end system testing 與 UE testing 分層。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 作為 channel emulator / signal generator 的 NTN 測試能力。
- [[R&S FSW]] 與 [[R&S FSVA3000]] 在 component testing / SAN transmitter measurement 中的角色。
- [[R&S Space Nexus]] 依 satellite trajectory 產生 [[R&S SMW200A]] fading files 的待請求 PC software 線索。

NTN signal generator solutions
[[NTN signal generator solutions]] 是 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]]（封面標示 12-2025；末頁標示 Last updated: 08/25）中用來整理 [[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]] 與相關 software options 在 [[3GPP]] [[NTN]] 測試中的 solution-level 應用框架。

NTN signal generator solutions › End-to-end system testing
來源將 E2E system testing 描述為對 UE、NTN payload、service link channel emulator 與 feeder link channel emulator 的 RF satellite link emulation。[[R&S SMW200A]] 需要 firmware version ≥ 5.30，並透過 B14 或 B15 搭配 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading 支援：

- satellite trajectory modelling。
- frequency-dependent atmospheric effects。
- longer path delays。
- enhanced Doppler capabilities。
- up to 1073 ms delay。
- up to ±1 MHz Doppler（pure Doppler）。

[[R&S Space Nexus]] 在來源中被描述為 PC Software，available on request，可依 satellite trajectory 產生 [[R&S SMW200A]] fading files。

詳見 [[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]]。

NTN signal generator solutions › 與 NTN validation / conformance 的關係
- [[5G NTN validation and testing]]：較寬的 NTN validation、partner collaboration、CMX500 / SMBV100B / Viasat / Gatehouse / MediaTek PR 語境。
- [[NR-NTN conformance testing]]：偏 UE / GCF / PTCRB / TS8980 / CMX500 conformance validation。
- [[5G NR SAN conformance testing]]：本來源新增的 Satellite Access Node 測試概念，聚焦 SAN transmitter、receiver、performance 與 OTA chapters。
- [[NTN propagation emulation and fading]]：既有 CMX500 PR 中 propagation emulation 與 fading 的概念；本來源補充 SMW200A dynamic fading / Doppler / path delay 實作線索。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › 文件依據
- 來源：[[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]。

- 來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]。
- 文件名稱：`R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications`。
- 文件代碼：`PD 3606.8037.22`。
- 文件版次：`Version 31.00`。

R&S SMW200A › Digital I/Q
- Standard digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K18`；wideband digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K19`。
- Digital I/Q input/output 可用於 [[R&S SMW200A]] 與其他 Rohde & Schwarz 儀器之間的 lossless connection，例如 [[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S SMM100A]]、[[R&S SMCV100B]] 或 CMW500 wideband radio communication tester 的 fading applications。
- DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface PAD-R`，level `LVDS`，connector `26-pin MDR`。
- HS DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface 40G PAD-R`，connector `QSFP+/QSFP 28`。
- Wideband HS DIG I/Q standard system configuration mode：40G up to `1.05 GHz`，50G up to `1.25 GHz`；advanced mode with `R&S®SMW-K822` input up to `500 MHz`，with `R&S®SMW-K823` input up to `1000 MHz`。

R&S FSW
R&S FSW 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 high-end Signal and Spectrum Analyzer 系列，依 Version 17.01（September 2025）涵蓋 8 GHz 至 85 GHz 型號，[[R&S FSW85]] 搭配 R&S FSW-B90G 可延伸至 90 GHz。

R&S FSW › 共通規格條件
- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時、warm-up operation 30 分鐘、符合指定 environmental conditions、遵守 recommended calibration interval，且若適用已完成 internal automatic adjustments。
- Frequency resolution：0.01 Hz。
- Recommended calibration interval：1 year。
- Operating temperature range：+5 °C to +50 °C。
- Permissible temperature range：0 °C to +55 °C。
- Storage temperature range：–40 °C to +70 °C。
- Display：30.7 cm WXGA color touchscreen，1280 × 800 pixel。
- Internal data storage：standard solid state disk ≥ 128 Gbyte。
- AC input voltage range：100 V to 240 V；AC supply frequency：50 Hz to 60 Hz / 400 Hz。

R&S CONTEST-based test systems › 架構層級
依 [[RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63]]：

- [[R&S CONTEST]] 執行於所有 system configurations。
- 在列出的 test system types 中，[[R&S CONTEST]] 執行於 system controller PC。
- System controller PC 執行 [[R&S CONTEST]] GUI、test applications、tools，並支援 devices 的 remote control。
- 系統主要測試儀器為 [[R&S CMW500]] 或 [[R&S CMX500]]。
- [[R&S CMW500]] 或 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 DUT 模擬 NR、LTE、WCDMA、TD-SCDMA、GSM 或 CDMA2000 network，建立 link 並執行 dedicated measurements。
- 系統可包含 spectrum analyzer 或 vector signal analyzer，用於 DUT transmitter measurements。
- 額外 signal generators、[[R&S CMW500]] 與 [[R&S CMX500]] 可包含 baseband fading，用於模擬 multi-path、Doppler 與 interference conditions。
- 所有 devices 透過 cable set 與 connection box 或 switching box 耦合。
- Auxiliary devices 包含 power meter 或 power supply。
- Climate chambers 或 vibration tables 等外部設備可 remote control，並納入 automated testing process。

R&S CONTEST-based test systems › 常見元件類別
依 [[RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63]]，R&S TS8980FTA/PRE system manual 中的 components / equipment 包含：

- System controller PC。
- [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMWflexx]]。
- [[R&S FSW]] vector signal analyzer。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] vector signal generator。
- [[R&S CMX-RF42]] FR2 RF combiner set。
- [[R&S CS-LDE3]] / [[R&S CS-LDE2]] power distribution unit。
- [[R&S SSCU-SE90]]、[[R&S SSCU3]]、[[R&S SSCU3-PRE]]、[[R&S SSCU3-PSU]]。
- [[R&S NRP]] power sensors / signal power meters。
- DUT power supplies，例如 [[R&S HMC8042]]、[[R&S HMP2020]]、[[R&S NGM201]]、[[R&S NGM202]]、[[R&S NGC102]]、[[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S NGMO]]、[[R&S NGSM]]。
- [[R&S OSP220]] open switch and control platform。
- Test chambers，例如 [[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S ATS1800M]]、[[R&S ATS800R]]、[[R&S CMQ500]]。
- Ethernet hub or switch，例如 [[R&S CS-HUBE]]。
- [[R&S CS-RUB]] rubidium frequency standard 或 10 MHz reference distributor / amplifier。

R&S CONTEST-based test systems › Operation and calibration
依 [[RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63]]：

- 所有 instruments power-on 後，需要至少 2 小時 warm-up time，才能達到符合 measurement uncertainty analysis 的 measurement results。
- Warm-up time 內不得呼叫 system PTC 與 device internal calibration capabilities，以避免 falsification of system calibration data。
- [[R&S CS-RUB]] warm-up time 遠超過 2 小時，因此建議永久連接 mains。
- Regular calibration 可確保 Rohde & Schwarz test system 的 optimum performance、correct measurements 與 availability。
- RF paths 已 calibration 時，system 需維持在 ±2 °C temperature range；否則需 recalibrate RF paths。
- Rated temperature range：23 °C ± 3 °C；relative humidity：20% 至 80%，non-condensing。

Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 合作，驗證 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 上 [[Next Generation eCall]]（NG eCall）的 implementation，並稱其符合 [[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 來源說 [[eCall]] 於 2015 年導入，且自 2018 年起成為歐盟境內所有新車銷售的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源指出，隨著 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks 逐漸 obsolete，emergency call systems 需要適配到 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] 在其 most recent regulation 中定義 NG eCall 將自 **2026-01-01** 起成為 obligatory。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 建立在 IP Multimedia Subsystem（[[IMS]]）networks 上測試 eCall systems 的 guidelines，涵蓋 advanced 4G LTE 與 5G NR technologies。
- [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 被描述為 5G automotive-grade platform，支援 high-speed connectivity、advanced positioning、Vehicle-to-Everything（[[V2X]]）、multi-band [[GNSS]] navigation 與 enhanced safety。
- 來源稱驗證流程使用 [[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester，作為 NG eCall voice and data transmission 的 comprehensive testing solution。
- 來源稱測試模擬 [[PSAP]]，並驗證 implementation at both ends with the [[EN 17240]]:2024 standard。
- 來源說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 4G 與 5G technologies，目標是讓方案 future-proof。
- [[Juergen Meyer]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Vice President Market Segment Automotive 身分在新聞稿中引述，稱此次 collaboration 為 future emergency call services 建立 new benchmark。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option 可在 realistic network conditions 下用於 NG eCall testing。
- 來源將合作定位為 mutually validating solutions、reducing effort、accelerating time to market for mutual customers。
- Press and media contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。
- 公司資訊段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 2024/2025 fiscal year net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，2025-06-30 worldwide employees more than 15,000。

- 來源為 lossy derivative；欄位中的 NaN、空白、箭頭與換行可能源自 Excel 轉換。

CMW500 to CMX500OBT_License_Swap_Process › 流程摘錄
長版流程包含三個角色 / 步驟：

1. Customer。
2. R&S Sales。
3. Contact Key Swap Team。

主要步驟：

- Request for keys to be transferred。
- Complete the swap process forms。
- 對 Unit A（[[R&S CMW500]]）take a device footprint，以 doublecheck content of Unit A。
- 填入 customer data。
- 填入 Original SAP# order（if available）。
- 填入 S/N of origin（Unit A）到 S/N of Target（Unit B）的對應。
- 列出要 transferred 的 keys。
- 將 completed forms 寄到 `keycode.swap@rohde-schwarz.com`。
- 加上 1C for key swap approval。
- 選擇 allowed keycodes；allowed keycodes 見來源中的 license swap 對照表。
- 收到 delete keys 後，由使用者、AE 或 customer 安裝在 Unit A。
- [[R&S CMW500]] 完成刪除動作後產生 Delete Confirmation Keys。
- 將 Delete Confirmation Keys 寄給 Swap Team，以確認刪除成功。
- Swap Team 依 credit account 在 Munich Order Processing 下單產生 Unit B 的 new keys。

短版流程補充：

- Customers who upgrade their Setup2 to [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]，R&S offers a license swap [[R&S CMW500]] → [[R&S CMX500]]。
- Old license swap process must be used。
- Forms 來源路徑標示為 Demopool GB1&GB8 / Bargain Portal / Keycode Swap - Inhalt/Keycodeswap。
- Permanent licenses 必須先在 [[R&S CMW500]] 上 delete，再收到 corresponding permanent licenses for [[R&S CMX500]]。

主要類型：

1. **placeholder code 被抽成真實 code**

2. **requires / excludes 欄位無法表達原文邏輯**  
   原文常見 `or`、`and`、model-dependent、path-dependent、quantity-dependent 條件，例如「`R&S®SMW-B13 or R&S®SMW-B13T`」、「`R&S®FSV3-K144 option or R&S®FSV3-K145 and R&S®FSV3-K148 options`」、「two or four installed options」。若表格只能填單一 code，會造成假缺漏或錯誤依賴。

R&S SMW200A › 主要 RF performance（Version 31.00，May 2026）
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]：

- Frequency range：依 RF path frequency option，RF path A 最高 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`；RF path B 最高 `100 kHz to 44 GHz`。
- Overrange：`67 GHz to 72 GHz`。
- Resolution of setting：`0.001 Hz`。
- Resolution of synthesis：`0.053 nHz nominal`，條件 `f = 1 GHz`。
- Frequency setting time：依 frequency option 為 `< 1.2 ms` 至 `< 1.8 ms`；with `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` 為 `< 4.0 ms`。條件包含 GUI update stopped、I/Q optimization mode fast、after IEC/IEEE bus delimiter、HUMS off。

### Evidence-supported opportunities
| Opportunity area | Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer angle | Supporting evidence | Evidence strength / caveat |
|---|---|---|---|
| NG eCall / IMS eCall over 4G/5G in automotive | CMX500 is not presented as a standalone signal generator/analyzer, but its RF unit provides FR1 vector signal analysis and ARB-based generator functions, and its NGeCall configurations include CMX500 application-test software and audio/IP options.[76][41][10] | eCall has been mandatory for new cars sold in the EU since 2018, 2G/3G circuit-switched networks are becoming obsolete, and the source says NG eCall will be obligatory from 2026-01-01.[71] | Direct automotive evidence exists, but the instrument role is mainly mobile radio tester/application test rather than standalone Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer.[31][72] |
| NG eCall validation with automotive modem platforms | CMX500 with CMX-KA098 is explicitly described as usable for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions.[31] | Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm Technologies used CMX500 to verify NG eCall functionality of Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF against EN 17240:2024, including voice and data transmission while simulating a PSAP.[7][31] | Strong direct evidence for automotive 4G/5G eCall test demand, but the source is PR-level verification and not a formal certification report or complete test plan.[9] |
| eCall GNSS testing | SMBV100B is explicitly listed as the vector signal generator base unit for eCall GNSS Testing configuration.[40][41] | The CMX configuration guide includes an “eCall GNSS Testing” section and points to an SMBV100B-based eCall GNSS test configuration.[34][41] | Direct signal-generator-to-automotive-eCall evidence exists, but the configuration guide is not a technical specifications datasheet or formal quote source.[36] |
| Automotive radar sensor validation / radar echo generation | AREG800A is an Automotive Radar Echo Generator for dynamic artificial object generation, with radar object distance, Doppler, IF bandwidth, 76 GHz to 81 GHz radar frontends, and HiL/OSI support documented.[61][60][63][68] | AREG800A supports hybrid and digital echo generation up to 3000 m, individual Doppler frequency shift per artificial object, velocity setting range ±500 km/h with AREG8-B9 and AREG8-B63, and HiL interface option AREG8-K109 with OSI and gPTP/NTP synchronization.[60][63][68] | This is a strong automotive radar test opportunity, but the vault explicitly says AREG800A is not an RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer.[5] |
| Automotive radar measurement ecosystem | Spectrum analyzer use appears in the AREG800A Doppler offset measurement condition, and vector network analyzer use appears in ghost-object suppression measurement conditions.[63][64] | Doppler frequency offset accuracy is measured in the IF domain with a spectrum analyzer, and ghost-object suppression is measured with a vector network analyzer in time domain.[63][64] | The evidence supports analyzer involvement in measurement methods, but it does not tie a specific R&S Signal Analyzer product such as FSW or FSVA3000 to automotive radar testing.[63][64][25][57] |
| 5G NTN testing where automotive is a named interested sector | SMW200A is presented as signal generator/channel emulator, and FSW is presented as signal/spectrum analysis instrument for NTN component testing and SAN transmitter measurement.[16][17] | The NTN source says 5G NTN-NR is gaining interest from chipset/device manufacturers, automotive, and satellite/space industry, and says SMW200A channel emulation capabilities for NTN include long path delays, enhanced Doppler, and customized dynamic fading.[83] | This is an automotive-adjacent opportunity with explicit automotive interest, but the evidence does not provide an automotive-specific NTN test case or customer requirement.[83][90] |
| NTN component testing with generator and analyzer pair | Component testing uses DUT, SMW200A, and FSW; SMW200A is summarized as frequency up to 67 GHz, overrange 72 GHz, RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz or up to 4 GHz with SMW-K555, while FSW is summarized as frequency up to 85 GHz, overrange 90 GHz, and analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz.[89] | The same source lists SMW200A signal generation software for LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18, OFDM, and custom digital modulation, and FSW signal analysis software for LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18, OFDM signal analysis, and vector signal analysis.[89] | The signal-generator/analyzer pairing is directly supported for NTN component testing, but the automotive link is only the broader statement that automotive is interested in 5G NTN-NR.[83][89] |
| NTN SAN conformance / channel emulation | SMW200A SAN testing key features include FRCs, test models, fading, AWGN, propagation models, TDL and moving propagation, SISO/MIMO, NB-IoT options, NR options, and B14/B15 plus K71 moving propagation.[82] | The SAN testing source ties NR SAN to 3GPP TS 38.108 and TS 38.181, and states SMW B10/B14 supports testing needs up to 160 MHz while SMW B9/B15 supports testing needs up to 200 MHz for TS 38.181 Rel.17 SAN testing requirements.[82][86] | This is strong for signal-generator/channel-emulation opportunity in NTN, but not directly proven as an automotive-specific SAN opportunity.[83][86] |
### Product / option mapping from the current vault
| Product line | Automotive-relevant demand that is actually evidenced | Confirmed product / option facts | Why it fits the evidenced opportunity | Gaps / quote risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | NG eCall over IMS networks for 4G LTE and 5G NR automotive emergency-call testing is evidenced by EN 17240:2024 context and Qualcomm Snapdragon Auto verification.[31][71] | CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD, and CMX-KA098 is named for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions.[72][31] | CMX500 was used to verify NG eCall voice and data transmission while simulating a PSAP, and the CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G configuration lists CMX-KA098 and CMX-KF671B.[7][41] | The verification source is PR-level and does not provide test case IDs, network parameters, IMS setup, GNSS setup, software versions, or pass/fail details.[9] |
| R&S SMBV100B | eCall GNSS testing is evidenced as a specific configuration-guide topic.[34][41] | The CMX configuration guide identifies SMBV100B as the vector signal generator base unit for eCall GNSS Testing and lists GNSS/eCall test suite items.[40][41] | This is the clearest current vault link between an automotive eCall use case and a vector signal generator.[40][41] | The configuration guide is not a technical specifications datasheet, and formal ordering, pricing, and product specifications need official configuration/specification sources.[36] |
| R&S AREG800A | Automotive radar echo generation is directly evidenced for automotive radar testing.[61][60] | AREG800A provides dynamic artificial object generation, hybrid/digital echo generation to 3000 m, per-object Doppler shift, ±500 km/h velocity setting range with AREG8-B9 and AREG8-B63, and 76 GHz to 81 GHz radar-band frontend support.[60][63][68] | It directly addresses automotive radar object, distance, velocity, Doppler, and HiL/OSI test needs.[60][63][68] | The vault explicitly says AREG800A is automotive radar echo generation and not an RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer.[5] |
| R&S SMW200A | 5G NTN-NR is stated to be gaining interest from automotive, and SMW200A is stated to provide NTN channel emulation capabilities.[83] | SMW200A is a vector signal generator that can be expanded to multichannel MIMO receiver tester, supports up to 8 signal sources and up to 64 fading channels, and has RF path A up to 67 GHz with overrange to 72 GHz.[22][92][93] | NTN evidence positions SMW200A for channel emulation, SAN testing, and end-to-end satellite RF link emulation with long path delays, enhanced Doppler, and customized dynamic fading.[16][20][84] | The automotive link is only stated as market interest in 5G NTN-NR, not as a documented automotive test case or customer project.[83][90] |
| R&S FSW | NTN component testing and SAN transmitter measurement are evidenced analyzer roles, and automotive is named as one interested sector for 5G NTN-NR.[16][83] | FSW is a high-end Signal and Spectrum Analyzer family covering 8 GHz to 85 GHz models, and with FSW85 plus FSW-B90G it can extend to 90 GHz.[25] | The NTN component-testing source pairs FSW with SMW200A and summarizes FSW as up to 85 GHz, overrange 90 GHz, and analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz for signal analysis roles.[89] | The current vault does not directly tie FSW to an automotive-specific NTN or radar customer workflow.[83][89] |
| R&S FSVA3000 | The vault only gives a general Signal and Spectrum Analyzer product series and an NTN slide saying 5G NR options on FSW/FSVA support Chapter 6 and 9 measurements.[17][57] | FSVA3000 models cover 10 Hz to 4 GHz through 10 Hz to 50 GHz depending on model.[58] | It may be relevant where a lower/midrange signal analyzer is acceptable for 5G NR measurements, but the automotive use case is not directly evidenced.[17][57] | The current passages do not provide an automotive-specific FSVA3000 opportunity or option stack.[18][57] |
### Scenario cut-in suggestions supported by evidence
| Scenario | Recommended evidence-backed bundle | Cut-in point | Unverified items |
|---|---|---|---|
| NG eCall platform validation for automotive modem suppliers | CMX500 with CMX-KA098, plus CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G configuration items such as CMX-KF671B where the configuration guide lists them.[31][41] | Lead with EN 17240:2024, PSAP simulation, NG eCall voice/data transmission, and realistic network conditions.[7][31] | Formal certification status, test case IDs, software versions, and full pass/fail details are not provided.[9] |
| eCall GNSS test setup | SMBV100B-based eCall GNSS Testing configuration.[34][40][41] | Lead with the configuration-guide evidence that eCall GNSS testing uses SMBV100B as the vector signal generator base unit.[40][41] | Formal SMBV100B specifications, pricing, latest orderability, and complete quote BOM are not provided by the configuration-guide passages.[36] |
| Automotive radar target simulation and HiL | AREG800A with relevant AREG8 options documented for IF bandwidth, Doppler, frontends, HiL, synchronization, and OSI support.[65][68] | Lead with dynamic artificial object generation, distance coverage to 3000 m, per-object Doppler, ±500 km/h velocity range, 76 GHz to 81 GHz radar support, and HiL/OSI support.[60][63][68] | This is not a Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer product opportunity in the strict RF SG/SA sense because the vault classifies AREG800A as automotive radar echo generation, not RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer.[5] |
| NTN component and SAN testing for automotive-interested 5G NTN ecosystem | SMW200A for signal generation/channel emulation and FSW for signal/spectrum analysis in NTN component testing.[16][17][89] | Lead with 5G NTN-NR interest from automotive and SMW200A capabilities for long path delays, enhanced Doppler, and customized dynamic fading.[83] | The source is a 2025 presentation, not a formal datasheet or price book, and it does not prove an automotive-specific NTN test program.[90][83] |
### Short conclusion
The most directly evidenced automotive opportunities are NG eCall / eCall GNSS testing and automotive radar echo generation, while NTN with SMW200A and FSW is a broader Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer opportunity where automotive is named as an interested sector but not tied to a specific automotive test case [31][34][40][41][61][83][89].

- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

NTN signal generator solutions › End-to-end system testing
來源將 E2E system testing 描述為對 UE、NTN payload、service link channel emulator 與 feeder link channel emulator 的 RF satellite link emulation。[[R&S SMW200A]] 需要 firmware version ≥ 5.30，並透過 B14 或 B15 搭配 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading 支援：

- frequency-dependent atmospheric effects。
- longer path delays。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › 主要 RF performance（Version 31.00，May 2026）
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]：

- Frequency range：依 RF path frequency option，RF path A 最高 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`；RF path B 最高 `100 kHz to 44 GHz`。
- Overrange：`67 GHz to 72 GHz`。
- Resolution of setting：`0.001 Hz`。
- Resolution of synthesis：`0.053 nHz nominal`，條件 `f = 1 GHz`。
- Frequency setting time：依 frequency option 為 `< 1.2 ms` 至 `< 1.8 ms`；with `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` 為 `< 4.0 ms`。條件包含 GUI update stopped、I/Q optimization mode fast、after IEC/IEEE bus delimiter、HUMS off。
- Frequency setting time in list mode：依 frequency option為 `< 0.8 ms` 至 `< 1.4 ms`；with `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721`、run mode live 為 `< 4.0 ms`。
- Level setting range：`100 kHz ≤ f < 1 MHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +8 dBm`；`1 MHz ≤ f < 3 MHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +13 dBm`；`3 MHz ≤ f ≤ 67 GHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +30 dBm`。
- Standard performance SSB phase noise 條件：CW，carrier offset `20 kHz`，measurement bandwidth `1 Hz`，level `10 dBm` 或 maximum specified output power 兩者較低者；`f = 1 GHz` 為 `< –134 dBc`，typ. `–140 dBc`。
- `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` ultra low phase noise 在 `1 GHz`、`10 kHz offset` 下為 `–144 dBc`，typ. `–150 dBc`；在 `67 GHz`、`10 kHz offset` 下為 `–105 dBc`，typ. `–111 dBc`。
- Pulse modulation 需 `R&S®SMW-K22`；一般 on/off ratio `> 80 dB`，部分高頻條件例外為 `> 65 dB`。
- Pulse rise/fall time（10 % / 90 % of RF amplitude）：低頻 frequency options fast transition `< 10 ns`；多數 20 GHz 以上 options fast transition `< 15 ns`；smoothed transition 多數條件 `< 200 ns`。
- Internal baseband I/Q、wideband baseband (`R&S®SMW-B13XT`)、I/Q wideband on：`f > 2.5 GHz` 時 `±1 GHz`；RF modulation bandwidth 可達 `2 GHz`。

R&S SMW200A
[[R&S SMW200A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 vector signal generator；依 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`（`May 2026`），RF path A 可覆蓋 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`，RF path B 可覆蓋至 `44 GHz`，並可由 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel MIMO receiver tester（來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]）。
